Xtreme Jetski Watersports  ·  St. Petersburg, FL

Jet Ski Rental FAQ

Age requirements, boater license rules, what to bring and what to expect before you ride.

Still have a question?

Call or text us. We're happy to help you pick the right ride.

Call (813) 538-4802 Check Availability

When should I arrive?

↓

Please arrive 30 minutes before your reservation. Groups of 5 or more should arrive an hour ahead. Your reservation time is your water time. Late arrivals may reduce your ride if we can't accommodate the delay without affecting other guests, and lost time isn't refunded.

Do you require a deposit?

↓

No deposit required. A valid payment method and a government-issued photo ID are all you need at check-in.

What rides do you offer?

↓

A Jet Ski Rental, a St. Petersburg Guided Tour and our Egmont Key Adventure, each available for 1, 2 or 3 hours. Two hours is the most popular. For a full day, ask about the 5-hour Ultimate Island Hop, offered by request.

What do I need to rent a jet ski?

↓

You must be 18+ with a valid government-issued photo ID to rent (international guests can use a passport). Riders 14+ may be on a jet ski with a parent or guardian on the machine, who signs a consent form. Passengers must be at least 8 years old and ride with a guardian.

Do I need a boating license?

↓

Yes. Florida law requires anyone born on or after January 1, 1988 to carry a boater education card to operate a jet ski. You can get a temporary card online in minutes before you arrive. Get your boater card here.

What's the max weight for a jet ski?

↓

Each jet ski carries 2 riders or 400 lb total. Over the limit? No worries, we'll set you up with a second ski. There are no passenger fees.

Where can we ride?

↓

On most days you can explore the Gulf of Mexico, Boca Ciega Bay and Tampa Bay. For safety, boundaries may be adjusted based on wind and tide. Our team makes that call each morning.

What if I've never ridden before?

↓

No problem. We specialize in beginners. Our crew gives you full instructions on the controls, steering and safety before you ride.

Will we see dolphins?

↓

Wildlife is never guaranteed, but dolphin encounters are very common, especially around Fort De Soto. Manatees, rays, sea turtles and coastal birds show up too. Our guides keep a respectful distance.

What happens if the weather is bad?

↓

We watch the marine forecast every day. If conditions are unsafe, you get a full refund or an easy reschedule.

What should I bring?

↓

Photo ID, your boater card if required, swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses, water shoes and a waterproof phone case for photos.

Is fuel included?

↓

Yes. Fuel is included, and there are no hidden fees.
